title: One Seamless Workflow With Clo-Set: Annotation & Comment
description:
CLO-SET is a cloud-based platform that enables users to collaborate easily with the entire clothing-making process through 3D file management, sharing, and real-time communication.

Streamline your feedback process with Annotation & Comment in CLO-SET, and experience a truly seamless workflow from review to revision! ✨

- Visit CLO-SET https://style.clo-set.com/aboutus
- Join Discord: https://discord.com/invite/G2eaK3PDSu   
- For any questions, visit https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us
transcript: In this lesson, we will learn how to develop designs using comments, annotations, and version upload in the content page. First, go to the workroom and click the content. Click the viewer tab and upload the sample tech pack file using the upload button. Once the file upload is complete, click the share button at the top right to collaborate with the designer. Enter the email, set permissions, and click share. Then, use the comment feature to request design development from the designer. The designer reviews the request and creates an initial 3D sample in CLO based on the tech pack. Once completed, upload the new version directly to CLOSet using the upload version feature in CLO. In the content page, update the workflow status to the next stage. Once the workflow status is updated to the next stage, leave a comment to notify completion and request feedback. The uploaded sample can be reviewed using the 3D sample. If you have any questions, please feel free to reach out to me at the 3D viewer and various viewing options, including different rendering styles and tools such as the strain map. Once the review is complete, click create annotation. Set the desired viewpoint to capture the exact area for feedback. Then use the drawing and edit tools to freely add annotations where needed. You can also use add new marker to leave multiple annotations at once. After adding all annotations, click save. Click each marker to view annotations in the annotation list and leave a comment to share feedback. Based on the annotations and comments, the designer updates the sample to the 3D sample. If you have any questions, please contact the 3D sample and upload a new version. Newly added colorways appear in the colorway list at the bottom and right panel. The new version information is also shown at the top left. Use these communication features to streamline collaboration and efficiently develop your designs. If you have any questions, please feel free to reach out to me at the 3D sample and I will be happy to answer any questions you may have.
markdown_content: ## Overview: Using Comments, Annotations, and Version Upload in the Content Page This lesson explains a seamless collaboration workflow in the content page using comments/annotation tools and CLO version uploads. It covers how to request design development, review 3D samples, add feedback annotations, and update workflow status through completion. ## Uploading a Sample Tech Pack and Sharing with the Designer This section covers uploading a tech pack, granting collaboration access, and initiating a design development request via comments. It focuses on the “Workroom” → “Content” → “Viewer” flow, then sharing and permission setup. 1. Go to the **Workroom** and click **Content**. 2. Open the **Viewer** tab. 3. Upload the sample **tech pack** file using the **Upload** button. 4. After upload completes, click **Share** (top right) to collaborate with the designer. 5. Enter the designer’s **email**, **set permissions**, and click **Share**. ## Requesting Design Development and Creating the Initial 3D Sample in CLO This section describes how the designer responds to a comment request by generating an initial 3D sample in **CLO** using the shared tech pack. It also explains uploading the updated version back into **CLOSet**. 1. Use the **comment** feature to request **design development** from the designer. 2. The designer reviews the request and creates an **initial 3D sample in CLO** based on the tech pack. 3. Once completed, upload the new version directly to **CLOSet** using the **Upload Version** feature in CLO. ## Updating Workflow Status and Notifying Completion This section explains how to advance the workflow stage after a new version is uploaded, then notify the designer and request feedback. It ensures the collaboration stays synchronized with the workflow. 1. In the content page, update **workflow status** to the **next stage**. 2. After updating workflow status, leave a **comment** to notify completion and request feedback. 3. Review the uploaded sample using the **3D sample** viewer and available viewing options. ## Reviewing the 3D Sample with Rendering Options (Including Strain Map) This section focuses on reviewing the 3D sample using different rendering styles and tools, including the **strain map**. It supports targeted review before annotations are created. - Review the uploaded sample using **3D sample** and multiple viewing options. - Use different **rendering styles** and tools such as the **strain map** to inspect the design. ## Creating Annotations for Targeted Feedback This section explains how to create annotations tied to a specific viewpoint, then add and edit markers for precise feedback. It includes saving and using the annotation list to communicate. 1. After review is complete, click **Create Annotation**. 2. Set the desired **viewpoint** to capture the exact area for feedback. 3. Use **drawing** and **edit tools** to freely add annotations where needed. 4. Use **Add new marker** to leave multiple annotations at once. 5. Click **Save** after adding all annotations. ## Viewing Annotations and Commenting in the Annotation List This section covers how to click markers to view annotations and leave comments that the designer can act on. It emphasizes using the annotation list to attach feedback to specific areas. - Click each **marker** to view annotations in the **annotation list**. - Leave a **comment** to share feedback tied to the selected marker/annotation. ## Designer Updates Based on Annotations and Comments This section describes the feedback loop: annotations and comments guide the designer’s updates to the 3D sample. It also notes how to request another iteration by uploading a new version. - Based on the **annotations and comments**, the designer updates the sample to the **3D sample**. - If questions remain, contact the **3D sample** context and **upload a new version**. ## Understanding Version and Colorway Updates in the Interface This section explains where new version information and newly added colorways appear in the UI. It helps users confirm that updates were received and where to find them. - Newly added **colorways** appear in the **colorway list** at the bottom and right panel. - The **new version information** is shown at the **top left** of the interface. ## Collaboration Goal: Streamlining Design Development This section ties together comments, annotations, workflow status updates, and version uploads into one seamless collaboration process. It highlights using these communication features to develop designs efficiently. Use the communication features—**comments**, **annotation tools**, **workflow status updates**, and **version uploads**—to streamline collaboration and develop designs efficiently.
